_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4), pre-registered 2026-09-05 BEFORE the base build (build-company-base.py not yet run; sources/site and sources/wayback collected).

membership: slug -> [expected verdict, basis, evidence class]. Falses are the classes this book carries: site-listed LP stakes in crypto funds (T5), the two 'Common' purchases of listed stock (standing public-purchase rule; flagged for Erik), founders' and ex-partners' companies (T4), namesake filers (D3). Trues span 2004-2026 and include the two derivation-driven members (Stripe 'Common, 2014' as a secondary; Numerai's management company).

stage: slug -> {stage, entry_year, basis}; every key row is anchored to the firm's own contemporaneous announcement post (first-party document naming the round) and, on the visible rows, a press document found 2026-09-05. The site's 'FIRST INVESTMENT' label is the layer under test, not the key: two rows where it disagrees with the record are in the set on purpose (Etsy year, Zemanta stage).

Gate: zero false members at high confidence; every candidate stage layer (site label 2026, archived labels 2013-2019, Form D band, post/press class 1) scored against this key before the grind trusts it.

autonomous-partners: Site-listed with a bare year (2018) and the excerpt 'a crypto-focused investment fund'; the firm's own post 'Investing in Token-Focused Funds' (2018-06) describes LP commitments to crypto funds. T5: a fund vehicle is not a venture-outcome operating company (fund-shaped list entry standing rule; a16z ruling 6)
multicoin-capital: Site-listed 2017, 'a thesis-driven investment firm'; LP stake per the 2018 token-funds post. T5 fund vehicle
blocktower-capital: Site-listed 2017, 'a leading cryptoasset investment firm'; LP stake. T5 fund vehicle
metastable-capital: Site-listed 2017, 'an investment fund'; LP stake. T5 fund vehicle
polychain-capital: Site-listed 2016, 'blockchain asset hedge fund'; the firm's 2016-12 post 'Numerai and Polychain' describes the LP commitment. T5 fund vehicle
placeholder: Site-listed 2018, 'a venture capital partnership' co-founded by USV alumnus Joel Monegro; LP stake. T5 fund vehicle
tucows: Site-listed 'Common, 2017': Tucows has been NASDAQ-listed since the 1990s; the 2017 position is a purchase of a listed company's common stock with no venture entry -> standing post-RIA public-purchase rule (§1), flagged for Erik because the firm lists it as portfolio
marley-spoon: Site-listed 'Common, 2019': Marley Spoon listed on the ASX in 2018; the 2019 position is a placement in a listed company with no venture entry -> standing public-purchase rule, flagged for Erik
anchor: Michael Mignano's company (Anchor, sold to Spotify 2019); the firm's own 2026-04-14 welcome post says 'We didn't invest'. A Form D naming Mignano is a founder filing (T4)
vanta: Christina Cacioppo's company (founded 2018, six years after she left the USV analyst program); USV is not an investor. Founder filing, not a firm position (T4)
fundera: Jared Hecht's company (founder-CEO 2013-2020, sold to NerdWallet); he joined USV as Venture Partner only in 2024-01. Founder filing (T4)
groupme: Jared Hecht's first company (2010, sold to Skype 2011); no USV fund invested. Founder filing (T4)
union-square-advisors: CIK 1368453, an M&A advisory boutique; namesake, external desk (D3)
union-square-park-partners: Union Square Park Partners LP (CIK 1636137), a hedge fund; namesake (D3)
union-square-partners: Union Square Partners L P (CIK 1394193), the PE firm formerly Capital Z Partners III; namesake (D3)
union-square-hospitality-group: Danny Meyer's restaurant group (Union Square Cafe Corp CIK 1634044); namesake (D3)
tacoda: The firm's first investment (2004 Series B; the firm's 2006-03 post 'TACODA Raises $12 million' confirms USV as an existing investor increasing its stake); site-listed 'Series B, 2004', acquired by AOL 2007
delicious: Site-listed 'Seed, 2005' (del.icio.us); the firm's 2005-10 post announces the investment; acquired by Yahoo 2005
etsy: Site-listed 'Seed, 2007'; the firm's 2006-06-05 post 'Etsy' announces its participation in the June-2006 friends round; Fred Wilson on the board; NASDAQ: ETSY
twitter: Site-listed 'Series A, 2007'; the firm's 2007-07-25 post announces the investment; USV led the $5M Series A (press); NYSE: TWTR until the 2022 take-private
tumblr: Site-listed 'Seed, 2007'; the firm's 2007-10-23 post announces the investment (with Spark); acquired by Yahoo 2013
zynga: Site-listed 'Series A, 2007'; the firm's 2008-01-15 post 'Zynga Game Network' describes the financing it provided with Foundry, Avalon, Hoffman, Thiel; NASDAQ: ZNGA, acquired by Take-Two 2022
kickstarter: Site-listed 'Series A, 2009'; the firm's 2011-03-17 post discloses the earlier investment; AllThingsD 2011-03-17 'Kickstarter Discloses Funding From Union Square, Betaworks, Angels'
coinbase: Site-listed 'Series A, 2013'; the firm's 2013-05-08 post announces the investment with Ribbit, SV Angel, FundersClub; Coinbase's own blog: $5M Series A from USV, 2013-05-22
duolingo: Site-listed 'Series A, 2011'; the firm's 2012-06-18 post; press: $3.3M Series A led by USV, October 2011
cloudflare: Site-listed 'Series C, 2013', exit detail NYSE: NET; the firm's 2013-12-17 post: 'we led CloudFlare's most recent round' ($50M Series C, closed Dec 2012, disclosed Dec 2013)
stripe: Site-listed 'Common, 2014': a secondary purchase of common stock in a private company is a venture entry at scale (T3; D5), overriding Phase 0's 'do not seed' note. Flagged for review as the derivation that flips a Phase 0 note
numerai: Site-listed 2016; the firm led the Series A of Numerai's management company (2016-12-12 post): an operating company that runs a hedge fund, not an LP stake (D7)
suno: Site-listed 'Series D, 2026'; the firm's 2026-06-03 post: 'participating in Suno's Series D'
dune-analytics: Site-listed (Dune Analytics, 'Dune Analytics' post 2021-08-12): USV in the Series A

twitter.basis: USV led/co-led the $5M Series A, July 2007 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2007/07/twitter/ 'We put together a financing'; hustlefund.vc 'How Union Square Ventures Backed Twitter, Etsy, Coinbase'). Site label 'Series A, 2007' agrees

etsy.basis: Friends-and-angels round, June 2006: the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2006/06/etsy/ ('participated in a small friends of Etsy round of financing' put together by Fake and Butterfield); vator.tv 'When Etsy was young'. Seed. Site label says 'Seed, 2007': the stage agrees, the year is the firm's later accounting — recorded, not adopted

tumblr.basis: $750K seed with Spark Capital, October 2007 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2007/10/tumblr/). Site label 'Seed, 2007' agrees

zynga.basis: $10M Series A announced 2008-01-15 (USV, Foundry, Avalon, Clarium, Hoffman, Pittman; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/01/zynga-game-network/ ; VentureBeat 'How Zynga grew'). Site label 'Series A, 2007': stage agrees, the firm dates the entry to the December-2007 close

kickstarter.basis: USV led Kickstarter's first venture round (2009, disclosed 2011: the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/03/kickstarter/ ; AllThingsD 2011-03-17 allthingsd.com/20110317/kickstarter-fesses-up-the-crowd-sourced-funding-startup-has-funding-too/). Series A; site label agrees

foursquare.basis: $1.35M seed round led by USV with O'Reilly AlphaTech, September 2009 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2009/09/foursquare/). Site label 'Seed, 2009' agrees

twilio.basis: 'We led a Series A investment in Twilio that closed in December of last year' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2010/02/twilio/ ; $3.7M). Site label 'Series A, 2009' agrees

stack-overflow.basis: $6M Series A led by USV, May 2010 (stackoverflow.blog/2010/05/04/announcing-our-series-a/ ; VentureBeat 2010-05-04; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2010/05/stack-overflow/). Site label agrees

duolingo.basis: $3.3M Series A led by USV, October 2011 (vator.tv 'When Duolingo was young'; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2012/06/duolingo/). Site label 'Series A, 2011' agrees

coinbase.basis: $5M Series A led by USV, 2013-05-22 (coinbase.com/blog/coinbase-raises-usd5m-in-series-a-funding ; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2013/05/coinbase/). Site label agrees

cloudflare.basis: $50M Series C led by USV and Greenspring, closed December 2012, disclosed 2013-12-17 (finsmes.com/2013/12/cloudflare-announces-50m-series-funding.html ; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2013/12/cloudflare/ 'we led CloudFlare's most recent round'). Series C -> Growth; site label 'Series C, 2013' agrees on stage, dates the disclosure

mongodb.basis: 10gen's Series A ($1.5M) led by USV, 2008 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/07/10gen/). Site label 'Series A, 2008' agrees; the row is listed as 10gen in 2008-2012 and MongoDB since

indeed.basis: Indeed's $5M first venture round with The New York Times Company and Allen & Company, 2005 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2005/10/indeed/). Site label 'Series A, 2005' agrees

delicious.basis: del.icio.us's first outside round, April 2005 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2005/10/del-icio-us/); the firm labels it Seed

tacoda.basis: USV's first deal, TACODA's 2004 Series B (site label 'Series B, 2004'); the 2006 post https://www.usv.com/writing/2006/03/tacoda-raises-12-million/ confirms USV as an existing investor. Series B -> Growth

lending-club.basis: 'our Opportunity Fund has led a $25 million Series D financing round' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/08/lending-club/). Series D -> Growth; site label 'Series D, 2011' agrees

return-path.basis: A 'later stage' investment (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/10/return-path/); site label 'Series E, 2008' -> Growth

oddcast.basis: Site label 'Series D, 2006' -> Growth; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2006/06/oddcast/ ('our eighth portfolio company')

meetup.basis: Site label 'Series D, 2008' -> Growth; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/07/meetup-the-original-web-meets-world-company/ announces the investment (July 2008)

soundcloud.basis: $10M Series B with Index Ventures, late 2010 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/01/soundcloud/ 'a few months ago ... invested in SoundCloud'). Series B -> Growth; site label 'Series B, 2010' agrees

funding-circle.basis: 'participating in their Series B financing, along with Index Ventures' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2012/04/funding-circle/). Series B -> Growth; site label agrees

c2fo.basis: 'we are excited to lead its Series B round' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2012/09/pollenware-c2fo/ ; Pollenware renamed C2FO). Series B -> Growth; site label 'Series B, 2012' agrees

dwolla.basis: $5M Series B led by USV, February 2012 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2012/02/dwolla/). Series B -> Growth; site label 'Series B, 2012' agrees

auxmoney.basis: Series B with Index Ventures at the end of 2012 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2013/06/auxmoney/ 'Until USV and our friends at Index Ventures invested at the end of last year'). Site label 'Series B, 2012' -> Growth

codecademy.basis: 'an investment in Codecademy as part of the company's Series A financing' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/10/codecademy/). Site label agrees

kik.basis: $8M Series A from RRE, Spark and USV, March 2011 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/03/kik/ 'a round of financing from RRE, Spark, and our firm'). Site label 'Series A, 2011' agrees

skillshare.basis: $3.1M Series A with Spark Capital 'joining a terrific group of seed investors' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/08/skillshare/). Site label agrees

turntable.basis: 'Union Square Ventures has led a round of financing for turntable.fm' ($7M Series A, September 2011; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/09/turntable/). Site label agrees

wattpad.basis: $3.5M Series A led by USV, September 2011 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/09/wattpad/). Site label 'Series A, 2011' agrees

duckduckgo.basis: $3M Series A led by USV, October 2011 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2011/10/duck-duck-go/). Site label agrees

edmodo.basis: Series A led by USV, December 2010 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2010/12/edmodo/ ; the 2011-12 post 'Edmodo: Adding Greylock and Benchmark' is the B). Site label 'Series A, 2010' agrees

shapeways.basis: $5M Series A with Index Ventures, September 2010 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2010/09/shapeways/). Site label agrees

work-market.basis: Series A with Spark Capital, June 2010 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2010/06/work-market/). Site label 'Series A, 2010' agrees

boxee.basis: 'its first venture capital round co-led by Union Square Ventures and Spark Capital' ($4M, November 2008; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/11/boxee/). Site label 'Series A, 2008' agrees

covestor.basis: $6.5M Series A led by USV and Spark, April 2008 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/04/covestor/). Site label agrees

clickable.basis: 'the company's first round of financing' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2007/07/clickable/ ; $6M with FirstMark). Site label 'Series A, 2007' agrees

behance.basis: $6.5M Series A led by USV, May 2012 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2012/05/behance/). Site label agrees

carta.basis: 'we recently led eShares' Series A round, joined by Spark Capital' ($7M; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2015/01/eshares/ , dated 2015-01-04). Site label 'Series A, 2014': stage agrees, the close straddles the year end

clue.basis: $7M Series A led by USV with Mosaic, October 2015 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2015/10/clue/). Site label agrees

quizlet.basis: $12M Series A led by USV, November 2015 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2015/11/quizlet/). Site label 'Series A, 2015' agrees

numerai.basis: 'USV is leading the Series A round of financing in Numerai's management company' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2016/12/numerai/ ; $6M). Site label is a bare year (2016): the post supplies the round

nurx.basis: $5.3M Series A led by USV, October 2016 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2016/10/nurx/ 'USV had led the company's latest round'). Site label agrees

upgrade.basis: 'excited to be Series A investors in this new venture' ($60M Series A, April 2017; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2017/04/upgrade/). Site label agrees

gotenna.basis: 'leading the Series B round for goTenna' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2017/04/gotenna/). Series B -> Growth; site label 'Series B, 2017' agrees

algorand.basis: $4M seed round led by USV and Pillar, February 2018 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2018/02/algorand/ ; press). Site label 'Seed, 2018' agrees

stash.basis: $37.5M Series D led by USV, February 2018 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2018/02/welcoming-stash-to-the-usv-portfolio/). Series D -> Growth; site label agrees

leap.basis: 'partner with ... the Leap team on their Series A financing' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2020/01/leap/). Site label 'Series A, 2019' agrees

noya.basis: Noya's $11M Series A led by USV with Collaborative Fund, April 2023 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2023/04/noya/). Site label agrees

suno.basis: 'participating in Suno's Series D round of financing' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2026/06/suno/). Series D -> Growth; site label agrees

pascal.basis: 'We are very excited to have led Pascal's Series A financing' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2026/07/pascal/). Site label agrees

zemanta.basis: 'join existing UK investors Eden Ventures and TAG as seed investors in Zemanta' ($1.1M, September 2008; the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2008/09/zemanta/). Seed by the firm's own contemporaneous words; the site label says 'Series A, 2008' — the disputed row of the set, scored as the record

splice.basis: $2.75M seed led by USV, October 2013 (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2013/10/splice/). Site label 'Seed, 2013' agrees

amino.basis: 'investing in them as part of their Series A round, along with Google Ventures, SV Angel...' (the firm's post https://www.usv.com/writing/2014/07/amino/). Site label agrees

_stage_readme: Slugs follow build-company-base.py slug_of(site name): the live site's rendering is canonical (MongoDB not 10gen, Carta not eShares, Numerai, Stack Overflow). Growth = Series B and later per taxonomy. Year is the round's close as the record states it; where the site's year differs the basis says so and the stage is what is scored.
